limits: Molecules that do not match the core are reported.
bio.jane/contract.question: What R-groups does each molecule carry on this core?

description: RDKit's R-group decomposition of a list of small molecules on a core given as SMARTS (default RGroupDecomposition parameters): per matched structure its core and substituents R1, R2 …, and the structures the core does not match. Indices are 0-based.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

molecules.description: the structures: one SMILES or molfile per entry.

name: decompose_r_groups

rows.description: per matched structure: its index and its groups (Core, R1, R2 …) as SMILES

summary.description: the decomposition in words, generated from this run

unmatched.description: input indices the core does not match
